description: This source file defines a SyncAdapter class for Android, responsible for background synchronization with a remote feed. The class handles network operations, XML parsing, and batch updates to an internal content provider, facilitating data sync for the app.

classes.name: SyncAdapter
classes.description: A subclass of AbstractThreadedSyncAdapter that performs network synchronization, parsing feed data, and updating the local content provider.

methods.name: SyncAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sync adapter with context and configuration flags.

methods.name: onPerformSync
methods.description: Main method invoked during sync, performs network data download, parsing, and database update.

methods.name: updateLocalFeedData
methods.description: Parses XML stream, compares with local data, and applies insert/update/delete operations in batch.

methods.name: downloadUrl
methods.description: Establishes HTTP connection to URL and returns input stream of data.
